learningObjectives: Identify the key stages of a data science workflow.
Differentiate data science, data analytics, and machine learning.
Recognize real-world applications of data science.

activities.title: Map the Data Science Workflow
activities.instruction: Arrange the workflow stages in the correct order.

content.concept: A data science workflow moves from defining a problem and collecting data through analysis, modeling, and communicating or deploying results.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Explore Data Science Roles
activities.instruction: Match each data role with its primary responsibility.

content.concept: Data projects involve different roles, with responsibilities ranging from data infrastructure and analysis to predictive modeling.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Data Engineer: Builds and maintains data pipelines
Data Scientist: Analyzes data and develops predictive models
Data Analyst: Creates reports, dashboards, and business insights
Machine Learning Engineer: Integrates and operates ML models in applications

activities.title: Identify Data Science Applications
activities.instruction: Select the scenarios that represent data science applications.

content.concept: Data science is applied to problems such as fraud detection, recommendation, forecasting, customer analysis, and anomaly detection.

activities.title: Build a Data Science Project
activities.instruction: Assemble the core components of a data science project.

content.concept: A data science project connects a real-world problem with data, analysis, modeling, evaluation, and actionable results.
